endpoints.hypothesis: Two updates may preserve baseline geometry but learn insufficient trigger specificity.
Four updates may improve painterly appearance and prompt adherence over two without increasing no-trigger regression.

hypothesis: Increasing a constant-rate SDXL LoRA endpoint from two to four updates may improve triggered still-life appearance while preserving exact object counts and untriggered photographic geometry.

protocol.limitations: Two training works, one validation work, two frozen prompts and two seeds each; 512px SDXL/Diffusers at fixed strength. Labeled assistant inspection, no independent blinded review, calibrated image metrics or deployed-runtime matrix. Selection only authorizes further evaluation, never production acceptance.
protocol.method: Decode all output PNGs. Directly inspect every frozen case/seed in all four conditions using labeled contact sheets and full-resolution details. Judge target oil-painted appearance, exact counts and geometry, no added objects or panels, photographic preservation without trigger, and activation relative to both base conditions. Fail an observed defect; use uncertain for unresolved activation. All criteria in all cases and both repetitions must pass; select fewest steps then endpoint ID. Loss is diagnostic only.
